conventions.session_unit: one synthetic trading session per array index; same rule for every market
conventions.warmup: null / NOT_AVAILABLE / WARMUP; zero is never a missing-value replacement
conventions.rsi_seed: first 14 close changes; Wilder recurrence; flat total change stays null
conventions.macd_seed: independent full-history EMA12/EMA26; EMA9 over valid differences
conventions.atr_seed: first true range uses index 1 previous close; mean of 14 true ranges, then Wilder
conventions.missing_session: reset seeds; do not bridge missing or incomplete observations
conventions.atr_basis: RAW_CLOSE OHLC only; adjusted/raw mix NOT_AVAILABLE
